name: 1.22.0-beta.19
notes: Find variants can now be done by hand: choose “By hand”, pick the base, and each other version is compared with it in turn. What is different shows in orange and is already chosen (green); paint to add or take away, then make a layer. One version can give several layers (a hat, then a scarf).

A layer made from one version is also put in every other version that shows the same thing (a hat in two versions); each layer has a switch for the version you are looking at. “Base” and “Rebuilt” let you check the result, and “Make the layered image” saves it with each version as a saved combination.
